description: One export: status (queued, running, succeeded, failed, expired), stats (rows and bytes written so far), truncated (more matched than it holds), error, and once succeeded download.url, a signed link to the file that works without a key for an hour (call again for a fresh one). Files are kept 7 days.

workspaceId.description: Optional. Run this call inside one of your child workspaces (org_..., from list_workspaces) instead of your own. Applies to this call only; the result says which workspace it acted on.

name: get_export
title: Get export
